_readme: Single source of truth for every legal, contact and pricing fact on the site. Anything marked FILL_ME must be filled in before the site will build. See build.js. Change a value here and every page that mentions it updates on the next build.

plans.name: Nap
plans.summary: The usual choice. Sleeps when nobody is using it.
plans.description: Hosting for one web application written in Node.js or Python, deployed from a public or private GitHub repository. Includes a MongoDB database on the same machine as the app, an HTTPS address at yourname.dormhost.app, support for a custom domain, 512 MB of memory, nightly database backups kept for seven days, and a choice of Mumbai or London. The application is stopped after fifteen minutes with no visitors and started again by the next request, typically in about 200 milliseconds.
features: MongoDB database on the same machine
Build logs and rollback to any of your last 3 builds
Sleeps after 15 minutes idle, wakes on the next request

plans.name: Awake
plans.summary: Never sleeps. For bots, workers and cron jobs.
plans.description: Everything in the Nap plan, with the application kept running at all times instead of being stopped when idle. Intended for workloads that cannot be paused: Discord and Telegram bots, scheduled jobs, queue workers, and anything holding a long-lived connection. Includes the same MongoDB database, 512 MB of memory, custom domain support, nightly backups and a choice of Mumbai or London.
features: Never sleeps, so the process stays running
For Discord bots, cron jobs and queue workers

annual.note: Pay for ten months, get twelve. Yearly plans can be cancelled at any time and refunded under the refund policy.
